description: A small white tray-like base sits on a green cloth, with several short, stacked white blocks standing upright on it and an extra block piece nearby. The left hand reaches in from the left to pick up the loose block, moves it over the base, and sets it onto the left-front corner to form another upright stack, then releases; the right hand stays near the front edge of the base, lightly holding it steady as the left hand adjusts the placement.
